claim: Even with SSRF protection fully enabled and correctly configured (InferencePool + RBAC), the current allowlist enforces only the host/IP component of x-prefiller-host-port, not the port -- an attacker with any network path to the sidecar can direct it to an arbitrary port on an already-allowlisted pod IP.
stance_target: gap-3: residual SSRF-adjacent exposure even when the Kubernetes-coupled protection is on, reinforcing that network isolation is required regardless of allowlist state
scope_conditions: issue #979 (open as of research date), reproduced end-to-end on a kind cluster; cross-verified against llm-d-router@main allowlist.go fetched same session, which still inserts only podIP/podName with no port
quoted_support: an attacker with direct sidecar pod-network reach can send X-Prefiller-Host-Port: <allowlisted-pod-ip>:<arbitrary-port> and the sidecar will dial that arbitrary port on the allowlisted IP.
numbers: 79 insertions / 35 deletions in the proposed unmerged patch
time_period: reported May 2026, still open as of Sep 2026

claim: A separate bug (fixed by PR #1647, matching current HEAD code) caused the pool-selector to be parsed incorrectly for the GA InferencePool API (flat spec.selector instead of spec.selector.matchLabels), which silently left the allowlist permanently empty and made every P/D request return 403 -- secure but completely non-functional.
stance_target: operational fragility of the InferencePool-coupled allowlist mechanism
scope_conditions: reproduced May 2026 on kind-llm-d-inference-scheduler-dev; fix present at HEAD as of Sep 2026
